titulo: Why Does Time Speed Up As You Get Older?
descripcion:
When you were eight, a single summer lasted forever. Now a whole year disappears and you couldn't tell me what happened in March.

It isn't your internal clock - that part barely changes with age. The distortion happens in memory, afterwards. And in 2020 the entire planet accidentally ran the experiment that proves it: everybody reported that the days crawled and the months vanished, at the same time.
